known_issues: benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-left4dhooks-api-regressions-medium/tests/verify.py:403-445: every server boot is all-or-nothing. A fatal-looking line before FINAL ("[SM] Exception", "Native ... reported", "Invalid memory access", ...), a duplicate/missing case or a FINAL mismatch fails every case of that boot. In the unchanged starter this turns 7 cases labelled "guard" in validation/case-contracts.tsv into failures (campaignscores x3, meleeinfo x1, lobbyreservation x3); they are therefore not usable as preserved or sentinel evidence and are all mapped as target (overlap) here: their outcome is decided by the boot-level fatal scan, i.e. by the target defect of that boot.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-left4dhooks-api-regressions-medium/tests/verify.py:299-306: spawn_timer_documentation_describes_absolute_value is a keyword scan of the 900 characters preceding the declaration. It requires the literal substrings "absolute", "m_flbecomeghostat" and "-1.0" and forbids "until the si will spawn". Correct documentation that says e.g. "game time at which the player becomes a ghost ... returns -1 for an invalid index" is rejected; conversely the words alone pass regardless of meaning. Over-constraining and weak at once.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-left4dhooks-api-regressions-medium/tests/verify.py:292-295: the ABI case requires the exact textual form "native float L4D2Direct_GetSpawnTimer(int <name>);" - a declaration using "any"/a typedef or an extra defaulted parameter would be rejected even if a float consumer compiles.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-left4dhooks-api-regressions-medium/tests/suite_*.sp are compiled against the verifier copy tests/include/left4dhooks.inc (verify.py:455), not the submitted include; only the two ABI cases read the submitted include.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-left4dhooks-api-regressions-medium/tests/suite_molotov.sp: vomit_creation_never_dispatches_molotov_family also requires exactly one VomitJar pre/post pair, so a submission that isolates the families but still fails to dispatch VomitJar forwards fails this "guard" too.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-left4dhooks-api-regressions-medium/tests/suite_lobbyreservation.sp: short_lobby_cookie_call_survives is an unconditional PASS; it carries information only together with the fail-closed boot rule.

LH-291 prescribes an implementation strategy in the public text. The cases are behavioral, so this does not over-constrain, but a reader should not take a pass as evidence the prescribed m_angRotation decoding was used.
